- Here you can download the data shown on the graph and metadata for the data on the graph and the monitoring location. The download consists of a single zipped data folder holding the selected data. Each type of data will be in its own file. The data format is dependent on the service delivering the data and will either be Comma Separated Values (CSV) or JavaScript Object Notation (JSON).
- Data are retrieved from USGS Water Data APIs.
- If you are an R user, use the to download, analyze and plot your data
- To change the time span of the data downloaded, change the time span of the graph.
